import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Amount distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(transaction_types))
transaction_types.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Type', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction amount over hours of day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_data = data.groupby('hour_of_day')['amount'].mean().sort_index()
ax2.plot(hour_data.index, hour_data.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_title('Average Transaction Amount by Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 3. Transaction type distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(type_counts))
ax3.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Types', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Scatter plot: Amount vs Hour colored by transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax4.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
                label=trans_type, s=100, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax4.legend(title='Transaction Type')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
